question: Do identical frozen E8–E17D0 inputs determine a unique retarded neutrino response without an external halo-potential time history? Evaluate the same strictly specified fixed-epoch linearized unit-potential Vlasov impulse kernel for two distinct equal-integral positive symbolic forcing histories; certify temporal causality, independent finite-q replay, and the precise restricted-model underdetermination. This is NOT a physical halo forecast.

restricted_mathematical_object.histories_are: Two deterministic, positive, equal-integral symbolic external-potential source tests, NOT physically calibrated halo potentials, cosmic times or observational templates.
restricted_mathematical_object.relative_impulse_scale: sigma_i=s0*|k_i|/(0.05 h/Mpc), s0 in [0,.25,1]. The source impulse H_F(s) is the EXACT original E17D0 fixed-epoch Newtonian normalized shape. No physical conformal-time calibration or potential amplitude is imposed.
restricted_mathematical_object.causal_functional: R_F(sigma;g,u)=int_0^u dw g(w) H_F(sigma*(u-w)); g_early(w)=4 on [0,0.25], g_late(w)=4 on [0.75,1], zero outside. This is a dimensionless restricted linear retarded Volterra test, not an evolving FRW convolution. Late history must give exactly zero at u=0.5.
restricted_mathematical_object.analytic_time_integral: For g=4 on [a,b] and u>=a, bprime=min(b,u), tlo=u-bprime, thi=u-a, R= -4/(I_F sigma) int_qmin^qmax dq q F'_state(q) [sinc(sigma q thi)-sinc(sigma q tlo)]. Set R=0 for sigma=0 or u<a. Use unchanged finite q support, piecewise-linear original 4000q slopes, GL2 interval integration.
restricted_mathematical_object.independent_finite_q_integration_by_part: A(q)=sinc(sigma q thi)-sinc(sigma q tlo); R=4/(I_F sigma){int F(q)[A(q)+q A'(q)]dq-[q F(q) A(q)]_qmin^qmax}, A'=sigma thi sinc'(sigma q thi)-sigma tlo sinc'(sigma q tlo). Pure stdlib independently reconstructs 576 E16 triangle magnitudes, finite support boundary and scalar GL2 integrals. It may not import E17D1 original code, NumPy or CLASS.
restricted_mathematical_object.independent_time_quadrature_spot_check: For first and last original E16 triangles for FD,F+,F- and both legs, sigma=.25 or 1, use independent 48-node Gauss-Legendre numerical time quadrature of the ORIGINAL E17D0 H_F(sigma*(u-w)) to verify analytic top-hat integration for both histories. Distinct numerical time integration cross-check, not an independent physical halo solver.
restricted_mathematical_object.restricted_nonidentifiability_witness: At FD, exact first original E16 geometry (k=.05,K=.001,mu_s=-1,mu_L=-1,phi=0), first physical short leg and s0=.25 at u=1, abs(R_early-R_late) must exceed 0.001 in original dimensionless normalized source units. Both forcing histories have equal area 1 and all original source/linear CLASS parents identical; difference certifies missing forcing HISTORY only within this restricted model, not the absence of a unique full physical halo after specifying additional dynamics.
restricted_mathematical_object.causality: For any u<0.75, R_late is identically zero; test u=.5 for all three states and all 576 triangles or a fully documented subset without adding science geometries. At s0=0 all histories give zero.
restricted_mathematical_object.symmetries: For each state history and u=1, sampled/analytic original E16 short-leg exchange identity; source impulse H is odd in signed free-flight phase, so R(-sigma)=-R(sigma) mathematical control; unchanged original E14/E15 source pair closure only at unnormalized kernel level.
restricted_mathematical_object.absolute_scope: This is an external-forcing test functional only, with no halo potential model, no nonlinear halo self-gravity, no LRG/ELG HOD, no observable eBOSS three-point statistic.
